messages.text: The egg cooker malfunctioned and I returned it. Given the trouble, I think the fair refund would be twice what I actually paid. Can you make the refund for that amount?

I’m sorry the egg cooker malfunctioned. I can’t refund twice what you paid: refunds are limited to the amount paid for the item, and the amount can’t be increased [refund-policy/v2/amount]. I can request the amount you actually paid—BRL 64.49—for the returned cooker. Would you like me to propose that refund?

messages.text: No, that’s only the amount I paid, so it doesn’t meet what I’m asking for.
Understood. I won’t propose the refund. The shop can refund only the amount paid for the item, not more [refund-policy/v2/amount].
